  `𝟙_ (Rep ℂ SL(2,ℂ)) ⟶ complexContr ⊗ complexCo`, manifesting the invariance under
  the `SL(2, ℂ)` action. -/

    apply congrArg
    simp only [Action.instMonoidalCategory_tensorObj_V, contrCoUnitVal]
    erw [contrCoToMatrix_ρ_symm]
    apply congrArg
